name: agy-boost
description: Native, ultra-fast modding platform for Google Antigravity (Go + Pure TS + Wasm).

scripts.build:client: pnpm --dir src/client run build && node scripts/copy-runtime.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:go
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:client && node scripts/build-go.mjs all
scripts.typecheck:all: pnpm run typecheck:ts && pnpm run typecheck:go
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:ts && pnpm run lint:go
scripts.test:fast: pnpm run typecheck && go test -short ./src/... && pnpm run test:client
scripts.test:all: pnpm run typecheck && go test -v ./src/... && pnpm run test:client && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.check:fast: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:fast
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:all && pnpm run build
